nodes.name: Webhook: Poll CR-03 Job
nodes.notes:
GET /webhook/cr03-status/<job_id> — same bearer credential as the submit
webhook. Uses the same PLACEHOLDER_HERMES_BEARER_CRED_ID; replace once.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    j.job_id,
    j.case_id,
    j.status,
    j.attempt,
    j.error,
    j.created_at,
    j.completed_at,
    r.report_md_path,
    r.report_json_path,
    r.risk_rating,
    r.recommended_decision,
    r.executive_summary
FROM car_cr03_jobs j
LEFT JOIN car_case_dd_report r ON r.report_id = j.report_id
WHERE j.job_id = '{{ $json.params.job_id }}';
